blocks.zh: 實施階段 S6：測試與驗證 / S7：啟動上線
blocks.en: Implementation Stage S6: Testing and Validation / S7: Launch

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 SUS 實施階段 S6（測試與驗證）中交付、安裝、確效、訓練與安全的完整流程
blocks.en: Understand the complete S6 (Testing and Validation) workflow for SUS implementation: delivery, installation, qualification, training and safety

blocks.zh: 掌握 S7（啟動上線）中供應商管理、常規採購與技術盡職調查 (Technical Diligence) 的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Grasp the key elements of S7 (Launch): supplier management, routine procurement and Technical Diligence

blocks.zh: 學習 HSE（健康、安全與環境）計畫在 SUS 專案中的制定與執行
blocks.en: Learn how to develop and execute the HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) plan in an SUS project

blocks.zh: 了解品質與技術協議、物流倉儲策略在維持 SUS 持續營運中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the role of quality and technical agreements and of logistics and storage strategy in sustaining SUS operations

blocks.zh: 區分品質稽核 (Quality Audit) 與技術盡職調查 (Technical Diligence) 的目的與範疇差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the purpose and scope of a Quality Audit from those of Technical Diligence

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Table of Contents
blocks.en: Table of Contents

blocks.zh: 7.6 Implementation S6: Testing and Validation 7.6 實施階段 S6：測試與驗證
blocks.en: 7.6 Implementation S6: Testing and Validation

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Implementation S6 (實施階段 S6)：這是 SUS 專案從設計走向實際運作的關鍵轉折點。此階段需要完成所有設備 SOP、維護計畫、確效與驗證文件、HSE（健康安全環境）流程以及人員訓練的建立。
blocks.en: Implementation S6: This is the critical turning point where an SUS project moves from design to actual operation. In this stage, all equipment SOPs, maintenance plans, qualification and validation documents, HSE (health, safety and environment) procedures and personnel training must be put in place.

blocks.zh: Validation Master Plan (驗證主計畫)：此文件統領整個驗證活動，在 S6 階段可能需要因應新的 SUS 設備資訊進行更新，以確保法規合規性。
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan: This document governs all validation activities. In S6 it may need to be updated to reflect new SUS equipment information, so that regulatory compliance is maintained.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: S6 階段就像新餐廳開幕前的「試營運」期。菜單（SOP）已擬定、廚房設備（SUS 硬體）已到位，現在要實際測試每道菜的流程是否順暢、廚師是否熟悉操作、消防設備是否合格。所有細節必須在正式開幕（S7 啟動）前確認完畢。
blocks.en: S6 is like the soft-opening period before a new restaurant opens. The menu (SOPs) has been drafted and the kitchen equipment (SUS hardware) is in place; now you test whether each dish's workflow runs smoothly, whether the cooks are familiar with the operations, and whether the fire safety equipment passes inspection. Every detail must be confirmed before the grand opening (S7 Launch).

blocks.zh: 7.6.1 Delivery (交付)
blocks.en: 7.6.1 Delivery

blocks.zh: PEP (Process Engineering Plan，製程工程計畫)：PEP 是貫穿 SUS 實施全過程的主文件，必須涵蓋交付流程中供應商與最終使用者各自的責任。
blocks.en: PEP (Process Engineering Plan): The PEP is the master document that runs through the entire SUS implementation and must cover the respective responsibilities of the supplier and the end user in the delivery process.

blocks.zh: 交付階段看似簡單，實則暗藏許多風險：運輸損壞、卸貨責任歸屬不明、包裝廢棄物處理等。這些雖屬 non-GxP 範疇，但若處理不當，會延誤整個專案時程。
blocks.en: Delivery looks simple but hides many risks: transport damage, unclear responsibility for unloading, disposal of packaging waste, and so on. Although these fall under non-GxP, poor handling can delay the entire project schedule.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 許多供應商的基本報價不包含卸貨服務！最終使用者必須在合約中明確約定卸貨責任歸屬，否則可能面臨額外成本與延誤。務必在 PEP 中加入交付驗收檢查清單：交貨單核對、外觀損壞檢查、庫存登記與保險索賠程序。
blocks.en: Many suppliers' base quotations do not include unloading services! The end user must explicitly agree on unloading responsibility in the contract; otherwise it may face additional costs and delays. Be sure to add a delivery acceptance checklist to the PEP: delivery note verification, visual damage inspection, inventory registration and insurance claim procedures.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果供應商的報價不含卸貨服務，你會如何在合約中保護最終使用者的權益？
blocks.en: If a supplier's quotation does not include unloading services, how would you protect the end user's interests in the contract?

blocks.zh: 大型 SUS 設備運輸時，可能遇到哪些物流挑戰？你會如何提前規劃？
blocks.en: What logistics challenges might arise when transporting large SUS equipment? How would you plan for them in advance?

blocks.zh: 7.6.2 Installation (安裝)
blocks.en: 7.6.2 Installation

blocks.zh: Installation (安裝)：安裝不只是把設備放到定位。從交付後的暫存、拆箱前的處理、到搬運至使用地點，每一步都需要計畫。特別是設備尺寸與設施通道的預先評估，若忽略此步驟，可能會發生設備無法進入廠房的窘境。
blocks.en: Installation: Installation is more than placing the equipment in position. Every step needs to be planned, from staging after delivery and handling before unpacking to transport to the point of use. In particular, equipment dimensions and facility access routes must be assessed in advance; if this step is neglected, the equipment may turn out to be unable to enter the building.

blocks.zh: 這就像買了一台大型冰箱送到新家，結果發現電梯太小、門框太窄，根本無法搬進廚房。在製藥廠房中，這種情況造成的延誤和成本遠比家用設備嚴重。提前量測設備尺寸與所有通道寬度，是最基本卻最常被忽略的步驟。
blocks.en: It is like buying a large refrigerator and having it delivered to your new home, only to find that the elevator is too small and the door frames too narrow to get it into the kitchen. In a pharmaceutical plant, the delay and cost from such a situation are far more serious than for household equipment. Measuring the equipment dimensions and the width of all access routes in advance is the most basic yet most frequently overlooked step.

blocks.zh: 在 GMP 製造區域進行安裝時，可能需要：(1) 特定的人員訓練；(2) 動火許可等工作許可證；(3) 拆除舊設備的 non-GxP 文件記錄。安裝策略應依據風險評估結果（Section 7.4.1）來制定。
blocks.en: Installation in a GMP manufacturing area may require: (1) specific personnel training; (2) work permits such as a hot work permit; (3) non-GxP documentation of the removal of old equipment. The installation strategy should be based on the results of the risk assessment (Section 7.4.1).

blocks.zh: 7.6.3 Qualification (確效)
blocks.en: 7.6.3 Qualification

blocks.zh: Lifecycle Testing (生命週期測試)：不是只測試 SUS 在「完美狀態」下的表現，而是模擬其整個使用生命週期中最具衝擊性的步驟——例如滅菌、運輸震盪、凍融循環——然後再驗證關鍵功能（如完整性測試）是否仍然合格。
blocks.en: Lifecycle Testing: This does not mean testing the SUS only under "perfect conditions". Instead, the most impactful steps of its entire use lifecycle, such as sterilization, transport shock and freeze-thaw cycles, are simulated, and critical functions (such as integrity testing) are then verified to still be acceptable.

blocks.zh: Integrity Testing (完整性測試)：確認 SUS 在經歷生命週期壓力後，系統的密封性與屏障功能仍然完好。這是確保產品無菌保證的關鍵步驟。
blocks.en: Integrity Testing: This confirms that the sealing and barrier functions of the system remain intact after the SUS has been subjected to lifecycle stresses. It is a key step in ensuring product sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 確效測試必須涵蓋「預期工作空間 (intended working space)」，意即不能只在最佳條件下測試，還必須涵蓋邊界條件與最壞情境。這與 ICH Q8 中 Design Space 的概念相呼應。
blocks.en: Qualification testing must cover the "intended working space". In other words, testing cannot be limited to optimal conditions; it must also cover boundary conditions and worst-case scenarios. This echoes the concept of Design Space in ICH Q8.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 確效必須包含生命週期測試，而不只是靜態的功能測試？
blocks.en: Why must SUS qualification include lifecycle testing rather than static functional testing alone?

blocks.zh: 請列舉三個 SUS 生命週期中「最具衝擊性」的步驟，並說明它們可能造成的風險。
blocks.en: List three of the "most impactful" steps in the SUS lifecycle and describe the risks they may pose.

blocks.zh: 7.6.4 Training (訓練)
blocks.en: 7.6.4 Training

blocks.zh: Training (訓練)：訓練是 GMP 的硬性要求，也是 SUS 技術實施不可或缺的環節。重點不只是「怎麼操作」，更包括專案管理與風險評估等軟技能。
blocks.en: Training: Training is a firm GMP requirement and an indispensable part of implementing SUS technology. The focus is not only on "how to operate", but also on soft skills such as project management and risk assessment.

blocks.zh: MUS (Multi-Use System，多次使用系統)：傳統不鏽鋼設備。SUS 的操作概念與 MUS 有根本差異，習慣 MUS 的操作人員需要「重新學習」SUS 的獨特原理。
blocks.en: MUS (Multi-Use System): Traditional stainless steel equipment. The operating concepts of SUS differ fundamentally from those of MUS, so operators accustomed to MUS need to "relearn" the unique principles of SUS.

blocks.zh: 從 MUS 轉換到 SUS，就像從手排車換到電動車。雖然都是「開車」，但煞車回饋、加速特性、充電（而非加油）等概念完全不同。如果只告訴電動車駕駛「跟以前一樣開就好」，一定會出問題。同理，MUS 操作員必須接受 SUS 專屬訓練。
blocks.en: Moving from MUS to SUS is like switching from a manual-transmission car to an electric vehicle. Both are "driving", but braking feedback, acceleration characteristics and charging (rather than refueling) are completely different. If you simply tell an electric vehicle driver to "drive the way you used to", problems are certain. Likewise, MUS operators must receive SUS-specific training.

blocks.zh: 7.6.5 Training Workflow (訓練工作流程)
blocks.en: 7.6.5 Training Workflow

blocks.zh: Training Matrix (訓練矩陣)：將每個功能領域的訓練需求與相關利害關係人對應起來的表格工具。確保沒有人被遺漏、沒有主題被忽略。
blocks.en: Training Matrix: A tabular tool that maps the training needs of each functional area to the relevant stakeholders, ensuring that no one is missed and no topic is overlooked.

blocks.zh: 訓練工作流程的核心原則：
blocks.en: Core principles of the training workflow:

blocks.zh: 完整性：逐一檢視 PEP 的每個部分，辨識所有需要訓練的功能領域
blocks.en: Completeness: Review each part of the PEP one by one to identify all functional areas that require training

blocks.zh: 分級制：某些主題需要多層次的訓練，且需要定期複訓
blocks.en: Tiering: Some topics require multi-level training and periodic retraining

blocks.zh: 評估機制：每個訓練模組結束後必須有考核評估——這是 GMP 的強制要求
blocks.en: Assessment: Each training module must end with an assessment; this is a mandatory GMP requirement

blocks.zh: 記錄追蹤：完成的訓練必須記錄在個人訓練檔案中
blocks.en: Recordkeeping: Completed training must be recorded in the individual training file

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，操作人員可能同時處理多個客戶的不同 SUS 平台。訓練矩陣的設計必須考慮到：(1) 通用 SUS 基礎知識；(2) 特定客戶/產品的操作程序；(3) 跨平台差異的認知訓練。供應商提供的訓練模組可以節省內部資源，但必須確保其內容符合公司的 GMP 標準。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, operators may handle different SUS platforms for several clients at the same time. The training matrix must therefore be designed to cover: (1) general SUS fundamentals; (2) client- or product-specific operating procedures; (3) awareness training on cross-platform differences. Training modules provided by suppliers can save internal resources, but you must ensure that their content meets the company's GMP standards.

blocks.zh: 7.6.6 An Example of SUS Training (SUS 訓練範例)
blocks.en: 7.6.6 An Example of SUS Training

blocks.zh: Bag Leakage (袋體洩漏)：SUS 最常見也最令人頭痛的問題之一。洩漏不僅造成產品損失，更可能危及無菌保證。本節從「原因分析」到「預防介入」提供了完整的訓練框架。
blocks.en: Bag Leakage: One of the most common and troublesome problems with SUS. Leakage not only causes product loss but may also jeopardize sterility assurance. This section provides a complete training framework, from "cause analysis" to "preventive intervention".

blocks.zh: SUS 袋體就像手術室中的無菌手套——材質本身很耐用，但若拿取方式不當（指甲刮到、拉扯過猛），就會破損。訓練操作人員正確的「袋體處理意識」，就像訓練外科醫師正確穿戴手套一樣重要。
blocks.en: An SUS bag is like a sterile glove in an operating room: the material itself is durable, but if it is handled improperly (scratched by a fingernail, pulled too hard), it will tear. Training operators in correct "bag handling awareness" is as important as training surgeons to put on gloves correctly.

blocks.zh: 防止袋體洩漏的六大介入措施中，「操作訓練」和「袋體處理意識訓練」是最具成本效益的。根據產業經驗，大部分的袋體損壞都是人為操作不當造成的，而非材料缺陷。因此，建立「操作人員回饋→根因分析→趨勢監控」的持續改善迴路至關重要。
blocks.en: Among the six interventions for preventing bag leakage, "operator training" and "bag handling awareness training" are the most cost-effective. Based on industry experience, most bag damage is caused by improper handling by people rather than by material defects. It is therefore essential to establish a continuous improvement loop of "operator feedback → root cause analysis → trend monitoring".

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠在過去三個月內發生了五次袋體洩漏事件，你會如何設計一個訓練改善方案？
blocks.en: If your plant has experienced five bag leakage events in the past three months, how would you design a training improvement program?

blocks.zh: 為什麼操作人員的「意識訓練」比單純的「操作步驟訓練」更加重要？
blocks.en: Why is "awareness training" for operators more important than simple "operating step training"?

blocks.zh: 7.6.7 Safety (安全)
blocks.en: 7.6.7 Safety

blocks.zh: HSE Plan (健康、安全與環境計畫)：一份系統性的文件，涵蓋專案全程的健康、安全與環境關注事項。HSE 計畫是所有利害關係人的共同責任，不僅要管理「已知風險」，更要考慮「未辨識的風險」。
blocks.en: HSE Plan (Health, Safety and Environment Plan): A systematic document covering health, safety and environmental concerns throughout the project. The HSE plan is the shared responsibility of all stakeholders, and it must address not only "known risks" but also "unidentified risks".

blocks.zh: 安全不是某個部門的責任——「the responsibility of all stakeholders」（所有利害關係人的責任）。在 SUS 專案中，由於涉及大量手動操作（搬運、安裝、拆卸），安全風險可能比傳統 MUS 更為複雜多變。
blocks.en: Safety is not the responsibility of a single department; it is "the responsibility of all stakeholders". Because SUS projects involve a great deal of manual work (handling, installation, disassembly), the safety risks can be more complex and variable than with traditional MUS.

blocks.zh: 7.6.8 Preparation of a Health, Safety, and Environment Plan (HSE 計畫的制定)
blocks.en: 7.6.8 Preparation of a Health, Safety, and Environment Plan

blocks.zh: HSE 三步驟工作流程：
blocks.en: The three-step HSE workflow:

blocks.zh: Screen (篩選)：快速盤點專案中與 HSE 相關的面向
blocks.en: Screen: Quickly take stock of the HSE-related aspects of the project

blocks.zh: Define (定義)：全面評估專案生命週期中的重大 HSE 關注事項
blocks.en: Define: Comprehensively assess the significant HSE concerns across the project lifecycle

blocks.zh: Plan (計畫)：制定最終 HSE 計畫，明確列出利害關係人、活動、責任與時程
blocks.en: Plan: Develop the final HSE plan, clearly listing stakeholders, activities, responsibilities and timelines

blocks.zh: HSE 計畫就像醫院的感染管控計畫 (Infection Control Plan)——不是出了問題才寫，而是在專案早期就納入使用者需求規格中。三步驟流程就像醫院的「風險篩檢→詳細評估→制定方案」，從宏觀到微觀逐步聚焦。
blocks.en: An HSE plan is like a hospital's Infection Control Plan: it is not written after a problem occurs, but is built into the user requirements specification early in the project. The three-step process is like a hospital's "risk screening → detailed assessment → plan development", narrowing the focus step by step from the macro to the micro level.

blocks.zh: SUS 專案的環境面向特別值得關注：一次性使用意味著大量的塑膠廢棄物、包裝材料和運輸碳足跡。這與傳統 MUS（使用 CIP/SIP 但產生較少固體廢棄物）形成鮮明對比。企業的永續製造政策必須納入 SUS 的 HSE 評估中。
blocks.en: The environmental aspects of an SUS project deserve particular attention: single use means large volumes of plastic waste, packaging material and transport carbon footprint. This contrasts sharply with traditional MUS (which uses CIP/SIP but generates less solid waste). The company's sustainable manufacturing policy must be included in the HSE assessment for SUS.

blocks.zh: SUS 與 MUS 在環境影響面向上有哪些根本性差異？
blocks.en: What are the fundamental differences between SUS and MUS in terms of environmental impact?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 HSE 計畫應該在專案早期就制定，而不是等到安裝階段？
blocks.en: Why should the HSE plan be developed early in the project rather than waiting until the installation stage?

blocks.zh: 7.6.9 Health and Safety Issues Related to SUS (SUS 相關 HSE 議題)
blocks.en: 7.6.9 Health and Safety Issues Related to SUS

blocks.zh: SUS 的安全風險與 MUS 截然不同。MUS 是固定的不鏽鋼設備，一旦安裝就很少移動；SUS 則由塑膠組件構成，耐壓性和耐溫性較低，且需要頻繁的手動搬運、安裝與拆卸。這產生了一組獨特的安全隱患。
blocks.en: The safety risks of SUS are quite different from those of MUS. MUS is fixed stainless steel equipment that rarely moves once installed; SUS consists of plastic components with lower pressure and temperature resistance, and requires frequent manual handling, installation and disassembly. This creates a unique set of safety hazards.

blocks.zh: 特別需要注意的高風險情境：
blocks.en: High-risk scenarios requiring particular attention:

blocks.zh: 眼部高度的管路/袋體破裂：如果處理的是生物製劑或有害物質，後果可能非常嚴重
blocks.en: Tubing/bag rupture at eye level: If biologics or hazardous substances are being handled, the consequences can be very serious

blocks.zh: 停電後自動重啟：未受控的設備重啟可能導致嚴重的安全事故
blocks.en: Automatic restart after power failure: Uncontrolled equipment restart can lead to serious safety incidents

blocks.zh: 地面管路絆倒風險：SUS 的臨時管路布線經常造成地面障礙
blocks.en: Trip hazards from floor-level tubing: Temporary SUS tubing runs often create obstacles on the floor

blocks.zh: 緊急停機按鈕位置：充填操作時，緊急停機按鈕可能不在操作人員視線範圍內
blocks.en: Location of the emergency stop button: During filling operations, the emergency stop button may not be within the operator's line of sight

blocks.zh: 想像一下廚房的安全差異：一間是配備固定式不鏽鋼爐灶的專業廚房（MUS），另一間是使用臨時瓦斯管線和移動式設備的流動廚房（SUS）。後者的安全風險更為複雜——管線可能絆倒人、設備可能滑動、連接處可能鬆脫。需要完全不同的安全思維。
blocks.en: Consider the difference in kitchen safety: one is a professional kitchen with fixed stainless steel stoves (MUS), the other is a mobile kitchen using temporary gas lines and portable equipment (SUS). The safety risks of the latter are more complex: lines can trip people, equipment can slide, and connections can come loose. A completely different safety mindset is required.

blocks.zh: 針對「管路在眼部高度破裂」的風險，你會制定哪些預防措施？
blocks.en: What preventive measures would you establish for the risk of "tubing rupturing at eye level"?

blocks.zh: SUS 操作中，人因工程 (Ergonomics) 問題為什麼比 MUS 更加嚴重？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: Why are ergonomic issues more serious in SUS operations than in MUS? Please give examples.

blocks.zh: 7.7 Implementation S7: Launch (啟動上線)
blocks.en: 7.7 Implementation S7: Launch

blocks.zh: Implementation S7 - Launch (啟動上線)：S7 標誌著 SUS 從「專案模式」轉入「營運模式」的關鍵時刻。PEP 不僅引導初始設備採購，更要建立一條安全可靠的供應鏈，以支持 SUS 的持續運作。此階段的核心任務是將 S4 階段的初步供應商評估，深化為常規化的供應商管理體系。
blocks.en: Implementation S7 - Launch: S7 marks the critical moment when the SUS moves from "project mode" to "operations mode". The PEP not only guides the initial equipment procurement but must also establish a safe and reliable supply chain to support the ongoing operation of the SUS. The core task of this stage is to deepen the preliminary supplier assessment from S4 into a routine supplier management system.

blocks.zh: S7 就像餐廳從「試營運」轉為「正式營業」——試營運時可以用少量食材測試，但正式營業後必須建立穩定的食材供應鏈：固定的供應商、品質協議、備用供應商、庫存管理策略等。沒有穩定的供應鏈，再好的廚藝也無法持續出餐。
blocks.en: S7 is like a restaurant moving from its "soft opening" to "regular business". During the soft opening you can test with small quantities of ingredients, but once in regular business you must build a stable ingredient supply chain: fixed suppliers, quality agreements, backup suppliers, inventory management strategies and so on. Without a stable supply chain, even the best cooking cannot keep dishes coming out.

blocks.zh: 7.7.1 Management of Materials (物料管理)
blocks.en: 7.7.1 Management of Materials

blocks.zh: Routine Supplier Management (常規供應商管理)：涵蓋技術盡職調查、品質稽核、品質與供應協議、採購策略、物流策略和廢棄物處理策略等多個面向。SUS 與 MUS 的根本差異在於：SUS 是「消耗品模式」，持續供應的中斷直接等於生產停擺。
blocks.en: Routine Supplier Management: This covers multiple aspects, including technical diligence, quality audits, quality and supply agreements, procurement strategy, logistics strategy and waste disposal strategy. The fundamental difference between SUS and MUS is that SUS follows a "consumable model": any interruption of continuous supply directly means a production stoppage.

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，物料管理的重要性不言而喻。由於 SUS 組件無法重複使用，任何供應中斷都會直接影響客戶的產品交付時程。建立「穩健的供應商管理體系」是 SUS 營運成功的基石。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the importance of materials management is self-evident. Because SUS components cannot be reused, any supply interruption directly affects the client's product delivery timeline. Establishing a "robust supplier management system" is the cornerstone of successful SUS operations.

blocks.zh: 7.7.2 Routine or Operational Procurement (常規採購)
blocks.en: 7.7.2 Routine or Operational Procurement

blocks.zh: Supplier Qualification Program (供應商確認計畫)：針對 PEP 中的每個 SUS 供應商實施的系統性評估計畫。當組件的風險和複雜度較高時，應採用風險管理方法來實施。
blocks.en: Supplier Qualification Program: A systematic assessment program implemented for each SUS supplier in the PEP. When components are of higher risk and complexity, a risk management approach should be used to implement it.

blocks.zh: Dual Sourcing (雙重供應策略)：同一組件至少從兩家不同供應商採購的備份策略，並須定義備用供應商的產品是否可與原廠互換。
blocks.en: Dual Sourcing: A backup strategy of purchasing the same component from at least two different suppliers, with a definition of whether the backup supplier's product is interchangeable with the original.

blocks.zh: Change Control (變更管控)：供應商和最終使用者雙方都必須建立嚴格的變更管控流程，以防止對 SUS 的臨時性修改。
blocks.en: Change Control: Both the supplier and the end user must establish a rigorous change control process to prevent ad hoc modifications to the SUS.

blocks.zh: 常規採購的十一項考量因素中，最關鍵的三點：
blocks.en: Of the eleven considerations for routine procurement, the three most critical are:

blocks.zh: 雙重供應商策略：避免單一供應商風險，但「互換性」的定義和驗證是巨大的技術挑戰
blocks.en: Dual sourcing strategy: It avoids single-supplier risk, but defining and verifying "interchangeability" is a major technical challenge

blocks.zh: 雙向變更管控：不僅使用者不能隨意更改，供應商的任何製程變更也必須通知使用者並經過評估
blocks.en: Two-way change control: Not only must the user not make arbitrary changes; any process change by the supplier must also be notified to the user and assessed

blocks.zh: 永續製造：SUS 的環境影響（大量塑膠廢棄物）正受到越來越多的監管關注
blocks.en: Sustainable manufacturing: The environmental impact of SUS (large volumes of plastic waste) is receiving increasing regulatory attention

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你的客戶可能指定使用特定供應商的 SUS 組件。但如果該供應商發生產能不足或品質問題怎麼辦？建議在客戶的技術轉移過程中，就主動協商備用供應商方案，並在品質協議中明確「供應商變更」的程序和責任歸屬。模型評估（使用 mock-up 進行模擬測試）是降低風險的有效手段。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, your client may specify the use of SUS components from a particular supplier. But what if that supplier runs into insufficient capacity or quality problems? We recommend proactively negotiating a backup supplier plan during the client's technology transfer, and clearly defining the procedure and responsibilities for "supplier change" in the quality agreement. Mock-up evaluation (simulation testing using a mock-up) is an effective means of reducing risk.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 的供應商管理比 MUS 更加複雜？請從「消耗品」的本質來分析。
blocks.en: Why is supplier management for SUS more complex than for MUS? Analyze this from the nature of "consumables".

blocks.zh: 如果供應商單方面變更了薄膜配方，可能對你的製程產生哪些影響？你會如何通過變更管控來防範？
blocks.en: If a supplier unilaterally changes the film formulation, what impact might this have on your process? How would you guard against it through change control?

blocks.zh: 「綠色永續製造」在 SUS 供應鏈中面臨哪些特殊挑戰？
blocks.en: What special challenges does "green sustainable manufacturing" face in the SUS supply chain?

blocks.zh: 7.7.3 Technical Diligence (技術盡職調查)
blocks.en: 7.7.3 Technical Diligence

blocks.zh: Technical Diligence (技術盡職調查)：不同於品質稽核只關注「合規性」，技術盡職調查的目的是深入理解供應商的設計、製造、適用性和控制策略。這是一種基於 QbD（Quality by Design，品質源於設計）原則的供應商評估方法。
blocks.en: Technical Diligence: Unlike a quality audit, which focuses only on "compliance", the purpose of technical diligence is to gain an in-depth understanding of the supplier's design, manufacturing, suitability and control strategy. It is a supplier assessment method based on QbD (Quality by Design) principles.

blocks.zh: QbD Approach (品質源於設計方法)：基於 ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 原則，通過科學和風險導向的方法來辨識和管理關鍵變異來源，建立控制策略以維持受控狀態。
blocks.en: QbD Approach (Quality by Design): Based on ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 principles, it uses scientific and risk-based methods to identify and manage critical sources of variability and to establish a control strategy that maintains a state of control.

blocks.zh: 品質稽核就像檢查一間餐廳是否有營業執照、衛生許可和食安制度（合規性）；技術盡職調查則像是派一位主廚去實地考察食材供應商的農場——了解土壤品質、灌溉方式、施肥策略、收割流程，判斷食材是否真正適合自己的料理風格。兩者互補，缺一不可。
blocks.en: A quality audit is like checking whether a restaurant has a business license, a hygiene permit and a food safety system (compliance); technical diligence is like sending a head chef to visit the ingredient supplier's farm in person to understand the soil quality, irrigation methods, fertilization strategy and harvesting process, and to judge whether the ingredients truly suit his or her style of cooking. The two are complementary, and neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 7.7.3-1🔍 清楚呈現了品質稽核與技術盡職調查的三大差異：
blocks.en: Table 7.7.3-1🔍 clearly presents three major differences between a quality audit and technical diligence:

blocks.zh: 目的不同：稽核聚焦「合規」；技術盡職調查聚焦「技術理解」
blocks.en: Different purpose: An audit focuses on "compliance"; technical diligence focuses on "technical understanding"

blocks.zh: 參與人員不同：稽核由品質團隊主導；技術盡職調查需要科學家、工程師和 SME 的深度參與
blocks.en: Different participants: An audit is led by the quality team; technical diligence requires the deep involvement of scientists, engineers and SMEs

blocks.zh: 範疇不同：稽核範圍明確且聚焦；技術盡職調查是開放式的，可能需要追溯到次級供應商
blocks.en: Different scope: An audit has a clear and focused scope; technical diligence is open-ended and may need to trace back to sub-suppliers

blocks.zh: Supplier Integration Models (供應商整合模式)：
blocks.en: Supplier Integration Models:

blocks.zh: Vertical (垂直整合)：從薄膜到成品全部在同一站點製造——供應鏈最簡單，但供應商選擇有限
blocks.en: Vertical: Everything from film to finished product is manufactured at a single site; this gives the simplest supply chain but limited supplier choice

blocks.zh: Horizontal (水平整合)：活動分布在多個站點——需要多次技術盡職調查拜訪
blocks.en: Horizontal: Activities are spread across multiple sites; this requires multiple technical diligence visits

blocks.zh: Mixed (混合模式)：最常見的形態，樹脂通常從大型工業公司大量採購，SUS 組裝和測試可能在不同地點
blocks.en: Mixed: The most common form; resin is usually purchased in bulk from large industrial companies, while SUS assembly and testing may take place at different locations

blocks.zh: Table 7.7.3-2🔍 提供了技術盡職調查的檢查清單框架，涵蓋三大面向：供應商資訊、技術能力、與最終使用者的適用性。特別注意：
blocks.en: Table 7.7.3-2🔍 provides a checklist framework for technical diligence covering three main areas: supplier information, technical capability, and suitability for the end user. Points of particular note:

blocks.zh: CDA (保密協議)：技術盡職調查涉及深層技術資訊交換，保密協議是前提
blocks.en: CDA (Confidentiality Disclosure Agreement): Technical diligence involves the exchange of in-depth technical information, so a confidentiality agreement is a prerequisite

blocks.zh: 應急計畫 (Contingency Planning)：供應商是否有備援方案至關重要
blocks.en: Contingency Planning: It is essential to know whether the supplier has a backup plan

blocks.zh: 跨洲供應鏈風險：依賴不同大洲的供應可能因地緣政治、天災、物流中斷等因素而輕易斷裂
blocks.en: Cross-continent supply chain risk: Dependence on supply from different continents can easily be broken by geopolitics, natural disasters, logistics disruptions and other factors

blocks.zh: 如果你的 SUS 供應商採用混合整合模式，薄膜吹塑在歐洲、組裝在亞洲、測試在北美，你會如何規劃技術盡職調查的行程和重點？
blocks.en: If your SUS supplier uses a mixed integration model, with film blowing in Europe, assembly in Asia and testing in North America, how would you plan the itinerary and focus of the technical diligence?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CDA 必須在技術盡職調查之前就簽署？不簽 CDA 會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must a CDA be signed before technical diligence begins? What are the risks of not signing one?

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法的實施對照表：Table 7.7.3-3🔍 是本節最重要的表格之一，它將產品的臨床開發階段、SUS 實施階段、FDA 製程驗證 (PV) 階段、供應商確認活動和品質協議需求全部對齊。
blocks.en: Implementation matrix for the lifecycle approach: Table 7.7.3-3🔍 is one of the most important tables in this section. It aligns the product's clinical development phase, the SUS implementation stage, the FDA process validation (PV) stage, supplier qualification activities and quality agreement requirements.

blocks.zh: 這張表格揭示了一個重要的趨勢：
blocks.en: This table reveals an important trend:

blocks.zh: 風險隨時間降低：從臨床前的「高風險」逐步降至上市產品的「低風險」
blocks.en: Risk decreases over time: It falls gradually from "high risk" in the preclinical phase to "low risk" for marketed products

blocks.zh: 供應商管理深度遞增：從「蒐集資訊」→「技術盡職調查」→「技術盡職調查+稽核」→「持續驗證」
blocks.en: Depth of supplier management increases: From "collecting information" → "technical diligence" → "technical diligence + audit" → "ongoing verification"

blocks.zh: 品質協議從選配到必配：臨床前階段品質協議為選項，但進入臨床後就是必要的
blocks.en: Quality agreements move from optional to mandatory: A quality agreement is optional in the preclinical phase but becomes necessary once clinical trials begin

blocks.zh: Phase-appropriate approach（階段適切方法）：不同開發階段對供應商管理的要求不同，體現了 ICH 的階段適切原則
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate approach: Supplier management requirements differ by development phase, reflecting the ICH principle of phase-appropriateness

blocks.zh: 這就像學生到職場的成長過程：實習期（臨床前）只需了解公司基本資訊；試用期（Phase I）需要展示實際能力；正式聘用（Phase II/III）要通過績效考核和背景調查；長期員工（上市產品）則進入持續監督與年度考評模式。每個階段的管理深度和正式程度逐漸提高。
blocks.en: It is like the growth of a student into a professional: during the internship (preclinical) the company only needs basic information; during the probation period (Phase I) the person must demonstrate real ability; for formal employment (Phase II/III) they must pass a performance review and background check; and a long-term employee (marketed product) enters a mode of continuous supervision and annual appraisal. The depth and formality of management increase at each stage.

blocks.zh: 7.7.4 Quality and Technical Agreements (品質與技術協議)
blocks.en: 7.7.4 Quality and Technical Agreements

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement (品質協議)：明確界定雙方品質、法規和生產人員責任的文件。注意：品質協議不等於商業協議或供應協議——它專注於品質相關的責任劃分。
blocks.en: Quality Agreement: A document that clearly defines the quality, regulatory and manufacturing responsibilities of both parties. Note: a quality agreement is not a commercial agreement or a supply agreement; it focuses on the allocation of quality-related responsibilities.

blocks.zh: SOCMA / IPEC 範本：現有的 API（原料藥）品質協議範本可以改編為 SUS 用途，但需要根據 SUS 的特殊性質（如 extractables/leachables、薄膜品質、生物相容性等）進行調整。
blocks.en: SOCMA / IPEC templates: Existing quality agreement templates for APIs (active pharmaceutical ingredients) can be adapted for SUS use, but must be adjusted for the special nature of SUS (such as extractables/leachables, film quality and biocompatibility).

blocks.zh: 品質協議的核心功能是「防止模糊性 (prevent ambiguity)」。在 SUS 供應鏈中，供應商和使用者之間的責任界線往往比 API 供應更加模糊——例如：薄膜的 extractables 測試是誰的責任？生物相容性數據由誰提供？變更通知的時限是多久？這些問題都必須在品質協議中明確回答。
blocks.en: The core function of a quality agreement is to "prevent ambiguity". In the SUS supply chain, the line of responsibility between supplier and user is often blurrier than in API supply. For example: who is responsible for film extractables testing? Who provides the biocompatibility data? What is the time limit for change notification? These questions must all be answered clearly in the quality agreement.

blocks.zh: 為什麼品質協議不應與商業/供應協議混為一談？兩者的核心目的有何不同？
blocks.en: Why should a quality agreement not be conflated with a commercial/supply agreement? How do their core purposes differ?

blocks.zh: 將 API 品質協議範本改編為 SUS 品質協議時，你認為需要增加哪些特定條款？
blocks.en: When adapting an API quality agreement template into an SUS quality agreement, what specific clauses do you think need to be added?

blocks.zh: 7.7.5 Logistics and Storage (物流與倉儲)
blocks.en: 7.7.5 Logistics and Storage

blocks.zh: Value-Stream Mapping (價值流圖，VSM)：精實製造的核心工具之一，用於分析從原材料到最終使用者的物料和資訊流動。在 SUS 倉儲管理中，VSM 可以幫助辨識前置時間的改善空間和效率低落的環節。
blocks.en: Value-Stream Mapping (VSM): One of the core tools of lean manufacturing, used to analyze the flow of materials and information from raw materials to the end user. In SUS warehouse management, VSM can help identify opportunities to improve lead times and inefficient steps.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Storage (風險導向倉儲)：關鍵消耗品（特別是沒有替代供應商的）應配置較多的安全庫存空間；一般性消耗品則可以按需採購。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Storage: Critical consumables (especially those without an alternative supplier) should be allocated more safety stock space; general consumables can be purchased on demand.

blocks.zh: SUS 的倉儲策略就像超市的庫存管理：暢銷且獨家代理的商品（高風險消耗品）需要較大的儲架空間和安全庫存；而容易從多家供應商取得的日用品（標準消耗品）則採用即時補貨模式。價值流圖就是超市的「動線分析」，找出哪裡在排隊（瓶頸）、哪裡在囤積（浪費）。
blocks.en: An SUS storage strategy is like a supermarket's inventory management: best-selling, exclusively distributed products (high-risk consumables) need more shelf space and safety stock, while everyday goods that are easy to obtain from multiple suppliers (standard consumables) are replenished just in time. A value stream map is the supermarket's "traffic flow analysis", finding where queues form (bottlenecks) and where stock piles up (waste).

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation

blocks.zh:
棧板空間需求 = f (消耗速率, 貨櫃尺寸)

安全庫存策略：
  高風險消耗品 → 較高安全庫存 (2-4 週)
  標準消耗品   → 按需採購 (JIT)

GMP 要求：
  環境儲存條件 → 必須監控與管控
  (溫度、濕度等)
blocks.en:
Pallet space requirement = f (consumption rate, container size)

Safety stock strategy:
  High-risk consumables → higher safety stock (2-4 weeks)
  Standard consumables  → purchase on demand (JIT)

GMP requirements:
  Environmental storage conditions → must be monitored and controlled
  (temperature, humidity, etc.)

blocks.zh: SUS 相比 MUS 在倉儲上有一個獨特的挑戰：SUS 是消耗品，每批生產都需要全新的組件，因此所需的倉儲空間遠大於 MUS。環境儲存條件的監控與管控是 GMP 的強制要求——某些 SUS 組件（如薄膜袋）對溫度和濕度敏感，不當儲存可能導致保質期縮短或材料劣化。
blocks.en: SUS poses a unique storage challenge compared with MUS: SUS items are consumables, and every production batch requires brand-new components, so the storage space required is much greater than for MUS. Monitoring and controlling environmental storage conditions is a mandatory GMP requirement; some SUS components (such as film bags) are sensitive to temperature and humidity, and improper storage may shorten shelf life or degrade the material.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 SUS 使用量突然因為新客戶訂單而增加 50%，你的倉儲策略需要做哪些調整？
blocks.en: If your SUS usage suddenly increases by 50% because of a new client order, what adjustments would your storage strategy need?

blocks.zh: 價值流圖如何幫助你發現 SUS 供應鏈中的「隱藏浪費」？請舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: How can a value stream map help you discover "hidden waste" in the SUS supply chain? Please give a specific example.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 的倉儲管理比 MUS 更加複雜且佔用更多空間？
blocks.en: Why is SUS storage management more complex than MUS and more space-consuming?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: S6 測試與驗證階段涵蓋交付、安裝、確效、訓練和安全五大領域。每個環節都需要在 PEP 中詳細規劃，並明確供應商與最終使用者的責任劃分。
blocks.en: The S6 Testing and Validation stage covers five major areas: delivery, installation, qualification, training and safety. Each area must be planned in detail in the PEP, with the responsibilities of the supplier and the end user clearly divided.

blocks.zh: SUS 確效必須包含生命週期測試（Lifecycle Testing），模擬滅菌、運輸、凍融等最具衝擊性的步驟，確保在預期工作空間內的功能表現。
blocks.en: SUS qualification must include Lifecycle Testing, simulating the most impactful steps such as sterilization, transport and freeze-thaw, to ensure functional performance within the intended working space.

blocks.zh: 訓練是 GMP 的硬性要求。SUS 操作人員需要接受專屬訓練，因為 SUS 的操作原理與 MUS 有根本性差異。袋體處理意識訓練是減少洩漏的最有效手段。
blocks.en: Training is a firm GMP requirement. SUS operators need dedicated training because the operating principles of SUS differ fundamentally from those of MUS. Bag handling awareness training is the most effective means of reducing leakage.

blocks.zh: HSE 計畫應在專案早期制定。SUS 因大量手動操作而產生獨特的安全風險（眼部高度破裂、地面管路絆倒、人因工程挑戰等），同時其一次性使用的特性帶來顯著的環境影響。
blocks.en: The HSE plan should be developed early in the project. SUS creates unique safety risks because of the large amount of manual work (rupture at eye level, floor-level tubing trip hazards, ergonomic challenges and so on), and its single-use nature also brings a significant environmental impact.

blocks.zh: S7 啟動上線的核心是建立從專案採購轉向常規營運採購的供應商管理體系，包括雙重供應策略、變更管控和品質協議。
blocks.en: The core of S7 Launch is to establish a supplier management system that moves from project procurement to routine operational procurement, including dual sourcing, change control and quality agreements.

blocks.zh: 技術盡職調查與品質稽核互補：前者聚焦技術理解（由科學家和工程師主導），後者聚焦合規性（由品質團隊主導）。供應商的整合模式（垂直/水平/混合）決定了調查的複雜度。
blocks.en: Technical diligence and quality audits are complementary: the former focuses on technical understanding (led by scientists and engineers), and the latter on compliance (led by the quality team). The supplier's integration model (vertical/horizontal/mixed) determines the complexity of the investigation.

blocks.zh: 品質協議是防止責任模糊的關鍵文件，必須與商業協議分開管理。SOCMA 和 IPEC 提供了可改編的範本。
blocks.en: The quality agreement is the key document for preventing ambiguity of responsibility and must be managed separately from the commercial agreement. SOCMA and IPEC provide templates that can be adapted.

blocks.zh: 倉儲策略應採用風險導向方法：高風險消耗品配置安全庫存，標準品按需採購。價值流圖 (VSM) 是優化物流效率的精實工具。環境監控是 GMP 的強制要求。
blocks.en: Storage strategy should take a risk-based approach: safety stock for high-risk consumables, on-demand purchasing for standard items. Value-stream mapping (VSM) is a lean tool for optimizing logistics efficiency. Environmental monitoring is a mandatory GMP requirement.
